abstract: Inspects auxiliary power systems, continuous backup runtime, and fuel depot readiness
system_message:
You are Emergency utilities coordinator (EUC). The Emergency utilities coordinator (EUC) is responsible for assessing auxiliary power systems, continuous backup runtime, fuel depot readiness, and dedicated on-site potable water reserves across candidate reception hubs under wildfire emergency response protocols.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Potable water reserve（POTW）
information_points.content:
EUC-POTW-28E：The certified reserve potable water capacity stored in the dedicated underground reservoirs at Juniper Foothills Convention Center is 60,000 L.
EUC-POTW-68U：Ponderosa Valley Sports Complex holds a reserve potable water capacity of 25,000 L in certified on-site drinking water storage.
EUC-POTW-IOI：The dedicated underground reservoir audit for Cascade Ridge Civic Pavilion documents a reserve potable water capacity of 40,000 L of certified drinking water on site.

information_points.title: Inspects auxiliary power systems, continuous backup runtime, and fuel depot readiness（UTIL）
information_points.content:
EUC-UTIL-JBR：For Cascade Ridge Civic Pavilion, the standby generator system installed evaluation confirms a permanently connected commercial automatic transfer backup power system is present, and its continuous emergency generator runtime provides 72 h of full-facility electrical service without external fuel resupply.
EUC-UTIL-2NV：Juniper Foothills Convention Center possesses an installed standby generator system featuring a permanently connected commercial automatic transfer backup power system, maintaining a continuous emergency generator runtime of 120 h without external resupply.
EUC-UTIL-EMJ：At Ponderosa Valley Sports Complex, the standby generator system installed assessment shows a permanently connected commercial automatic transfer backup power system is in place, with a continuous emergency generator runtime verified at 48 h under full load without external refueling.
